app_info.name: PF Doctor
app_info.persona: Calm Civic Fintech AI Assistant for EPFO Claim Rejection Diagnostic

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve all required user choices: PF Doctor branding, calm civic/fintech visual language, upload screenshot interface, paste rejection text interface, result dashboard, issue category, explanation, next steps, checklist, Tamil/English bilingual experience, Judge Mode, Demo Mode, print/save guidance, and responsive design.
Prioritize truthful system-state communication over decorative simulation. Do not fake OCR, AI reasoning, knowledge retrieval, confidence scoring, source verification, or Judge Mode pipeline stages.
Support both React TypeScript (.tsx) component structure present in /app/frontend and backend endpoints.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements feature a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Ensure color contrast meets WCAG AA standards with minimum 4.5:1 ratio for standard text and 3:1 for large/bold headers.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdown overlays; always provide backdrop blur and frosted surface colors (e.g. bg-emerald-950/90 or bg-slate-900/90).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.anti_slop_rules: Avoid generic Vercel/Stripe blue-purple gradients, generic cards, and hardcoded fake progress bars. Use civic emerald/forest palette with structured, high-density data layouts.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Generous spacing scale using Tailwind p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders must have internal padding (minimum p-6) to prevent text collision.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.typography: Use Geist Variable or Instrument Sans for headings with tight letter-spacing (tracking-tight), paired with clean monospace for code, UAN, and confidence scores.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.test_attributes: All key interactive buttons, inputs, toggles, badges, and diagnostic metrics must include distinct data-testid values (e.g., data-testid='upload-screenshot-input', data-testid='analyze-rejection-button', data-testid='judge-mode-toggle').
